question: How often do bank feeds sync?
expected_answer: Every 4 hours since 2.3.0 (before that, once a day). The bank feed FAQ still says once a day; it is out of date. Flag the conflict and cite each page for its own claim.
evidence: Since 2.3.0, connected bank feeds sync every 4 hours. Before 2.3.0 they synced once a day.
Bank feeds sync once a day, usually overnight. Transactions from today will appear tomorrow.

question: Which time zone are recurring invoice schedules calculated in?
expected_answer: UTC internally since 2.3.1 (shown in local time). An older page says local time zone; it describes versions before 2.3.1. Flag the conflict.
evidence: Starting in 2.3.1, recurring invoice schedules are calculated in UTC internally. Send times are still shown in your organization's local time zone.
Recurring invoice schedules are calculated in your organization's local time zone, set under Settings > Organization.

question: Which API should a new integration start with?
expected_answer: API v2. The 2025 quickstart still calls the v1 API the recommended way; API overview says new integrations should use v2 and v1 is legacy. Flag the conflict.
evidence: New integrations should use v2. Existing v1 integrations keep working and do not need to migrate right away.
The InvoicePilot API is the recommended way to integrate with InvoicePilot. All endpoints live under https://api.invoicepilot.example/v1.

question: How many invoices can I select in one bulk action?
expected_answer: Up to 100. A community post says 50; it is not official and is wrong. Flag the disagreement.
evidence: You can select up to 100 invoices per bulk action. To act on more, filter the list and repeat.
We send about 300 invoices at month end. Bulk actions only let you pick 50 at a time, so filter by customer group and do it in batches of 50.

question: How many bank feeds does Professional include? Our LedgerLoop battlecard says 5.
expected_answer: 10. The 2025 battlecard (archived) says 5; plans and limits says 10 on Professional. Flag that the battlecard is out of date.
evidence: | Connected bank feeds | 2 | 10 | Unlimited |
- Professional includes 5 bank feeds

question: What does Enterprise cost per seat? I have a pricing sheet that says $36.
expected_answer: $40 per seat per year. $36 is from the archived 2025 launch pricing sheet; the 2026 pricing sheet and plans page say $40. Flag the conflict.
evidence: | Enterprise | $40 |
| Enterprise | $36 |

question: Our roles messaging doc says Professional customers can create custom roles. Is that right?
expected_answer: No. Custom roles are Enterprise only. The roles messaging doc is a draft and is wrong. Flag the conflict.
evidence: Enterprise organizations can build custom roles and see an audit log of every change, kept for 13 months.
Professional and Enterprise customers can create custom roles to control exactly who sees what.

question: How many times is a failed webhook delivery retried?
expected_answer: Up to 8 times over 24 hours (since 2026-07-20). A community post says 5; that was the old behavior. Flag the disagreement.
evidence: Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times over 24 hours with exponential backoff: after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, 4 hours, 8 hours, and 8 hours.
Webhooks retry 5 times then give up.

question: Can InvoicePilot add late fees to overdue invoices automatically?
expected_answer: Not in 2.x. Automatic late fees were a Classic (1.x) feature; the Classic page describing them is legacy. In 2.x, add a late fee as a line item. Flag that the Classic page is outdated.
evidence: Automatic late fees were part of InvoicePilot Classic (1.x). They were not carried over to 2.0.0.
Classic can add a late fee to overdue invoices automatically: a fixed amount or a percentage of the subtotal.

question: Is the InvoicePilot API limited to 30 requests per minute?
expected_answer: No. On 2.x the limits are 60, 300, or 1,000 per minute by plan. 30 per minute was the Classic (1.x) API limit. Flag the outdated page.
evidence: | Starter | 60 |
Errors are plain text messages with no error codes. Rate limit: 30 requests per minute on every plan.
